The Towers are Megabuildings. They are the window project of Yggdrasil in Containment Zone Aleph, and it's always provided public opinion support for the legitimacy of the Containment Wall.
Lower Levels of the Towers
For the residents of the Buffer Sections who have just enough money to escape life in the Camps, the lower section of The Towers is perfect for them. They make their living here among the intricate air corridors between the buildings that form three-dimensional living spaces. Generally speaking, it is more safe and sturdy than living in the Camps. The only downside is that this place doesn't get much sunlight. Furthermore, many informants and agents have been sent here out of convenience. In the eyes of the less fortunate, these people are somehow living an otherworldly life that isn't standard within the Containment Zone. As such, they have labeled this area as part of The Towers.
Upper Levels of the Towers:
Even in the Containment Zone, social hierarchy continues to exist.
In the beginning, Yggdrasil Enterprises delivered "humanitarian aid" to residents inside the Buffer Sections. A new platform of buildings was built atop existing tall buildings using flexible lightweight alloy materials. The main purpose was to guard against the Titans, who might appear at any time, as well as contain the spread of the Titagen contamination. After a short period of development, this area has become a high-class community of wealthy and influential people. If you pay enough money, the view from the spacious suites dozens of floors up is enough to make you forget you're in the Containment Zone.

entries.name: The Younger Sister
entries.content:
After the Adjutant develops Empathic Ganglia, he starts receiving visions of a young girl, "The Younger Sister", as seen through the memories of her unnamed older brother.
Petite, long grey hair, red eyes, white dress with red ribbons.
The Younger Sister is actually 𝜏's daughter, but 𝜏 divorced her husband and subsequently all but forgot about her children, leaving them to fend for themselves up until the girl's death after the First Descent. According to Edda, the sister's consciousness still exists in Vahalla, apparently living in bliss, judging by Edda's taunts at 𝜏.

entries.name: Emissary
entries.content:
Emissary: "Emissary of Gods", ​​A high-ranking position within The Adventists.
Their female members usually wear a white nun's veil and attire, and hold a white staff inlaid with Titagen
Some of them may have questionable powers as well. For example, an Emissary once revived severely injured Gavin, and caused snow in the process

entries.name: Husk Sentinel
entries.content:
Husk Sentinel
An ancient robot (golem) created by the Typha people that stands at about three meters tall. Upon deconstruction, modern researchers discovered that it is powered by a kind of rare crystal. Researchers have found that the husk sentinels also have the ability to break apart and move large boulders, enabling them to assist in engineering projects such as building temples and repairing houses. In local Typha religion, these large sentinels are seen as demigods that escort people to the realm of the higher gods at the end of one's physical life. However, researchers have not found any evidence of how this journey to the spiritual world might actually occur. Can fire scorching beams from their crystals.

entries.name: Injection Bullet
entries.content:
Injection Bullet
Special bullets made from cerebrospinal fluid extracted from the Adjutant.
Using such bullets against Flooded Manifestations can greatly counteract their symptoms of Flooding.

entries.name: Typha
entries.content:
According to records provided by the Ramses Group, an ancient people known as the Typha inhabited the island several thousand years ago. The Typha believed that the physical world is nothing more than a reflection of the spiritual world on a vast lake, the latter world being an idyllic realm of pure energy composed of people's wishes and fantasies wherein all consciousness and physical matter originate. The spiritual world knows no suffering, no death, and no extrinsic concepts tainted by worldly empiricism - there are only innate tranquility and absolute truth.
The Typha people believed that when a high priest ate a shadow lotus, a special plant on Yallu Island, they could enter the spiritual world in their dreams, where they could acquire knowledge and truth to bring back to the physical world. For generations, they relied on this mystical method to progress their civilization... However, it eventually fell, leaving nothing but various ruins scattered across the island today.

entries.name: Demiurge Handmaiden
entries.content:
When ordinary people come in contact with the Awakening Dust, most of them are overpowered and briefly set ablaze before succumbing to death. However, a handful of "fortunate" ones are able to endure this process and merge with the Awakening Dust, transforming into Demiurge Handmaidens. These monstrous beings serve as faithful servants to the Demiurges. Although they retain their consciousness and intelligence and can act independently, they often must follow the commands of the Demiurges. To the Demiurges, these Handmaidens are not much different from the ordinary individuals controlled by the dust, except that they are more valuable.
Their appearance is usually a tall and voluptuous female with blue skin that pulsates with purple energy, absolutely massive breasts and hips, white and purple bodysuit, dark blue levitation half-cape, white veil covered with multiple hexagonal patterns. can summon a silver Titagen double bladed spear as weapon.

entries.name: Awakening Dust
entries.content:
Awakening Dust
Though resembling a fungus with silk-like feelers, it was discovered to be an artificial and highly sophisticated micro-robot. It's hard to produce, and is regarded as a crucial secret weapon by Rozan Khwarenah. This robot can interfere with the nerves like parasites, influencing how the hosts think and behave, including their cognitive function. Demiurges can utilize Awakening Dust to manipulate people, and even Manifestations by affecting their Theotropic Nerves and causing rapid Flooding.
The emergence of Awakening Dust has significantly impacted existing research in the field of Titagen and Theotropic Nerves. Still, only a few researchers and unfortunate people to have experienced it know about this terrible invention.

entries.name: Regius
entries.content: Regius is a guidance AI developed by Yggdrasil Enterprises, crucial for providing services in the smart city project. Previously widespread in the city, many terminals were destroyed in the Descent, leaving only a few operational ones that now rely on outdated data.

entries.name: Inner Sanctum
entries.content:
Inner Sanctum:
"Tranquil, empty, and pristinely pure. A realm that belongs to you, from beginning to end."
The Inner Sanctum is a spiritual realm created by the Adjutant through his own understanding and will after absorbing the tree of Yehrus and briefly connecting to Valhalla. Edda (trapped) resides in it.

entries.name: Astrolabe Emblem
entries.content:
Astrolabe Emblem
A symbol of Yehrus' aerospace industry. Through this arduous journey, a nation and people reach the sky.

entries.name: Bunker
entries.content:
The Bunker is the collective name for a series of underground defensive structures in Yehrus.
As early as the last century, the Bunker was already being used as a key location of defense during conflicts in Yehrus. As the Yehrus Empire came to an end, the imperial family fled to the Bunker in a last-ditch effort to survive. However, no fortifications could save their tyranny – the guerrilla revolutionaries led by Gustav made sure that the Bunker became the last emperor's grave.
After the First Federation War, Gustav built the first-level bunker beneath the old imperial bunker as a place for support personnel to live and store supplies. Even today, some of the older generation of Yehrus still call it "Gustav Bunker."
In 2047, during the chaotic war that followed the disintegration of the Yehrus Federation, various warlords and separatist forces began using the Bunker, though in their own separate interests. Once again, the fortress was dug deeper, with the second-level bunker being built beneath "Gustav Bunker."
In 2057, after the Descent, Barentsy Pribor Ltd. continued to expand the Bunker even further and moved a large number of people underground to avoid Titagen contamination. Today, the Yehrus Bunker has essentially become an underground city with its own civilian facilities, transportation, water, and electricity.

entries.name: Hard-Maglev Rail
entries.content:
Hard-Maglev Rail
A massive hard-magnet-levitation railroad network built during the time of the former Yehrus Federation. It connects the east and west regions of Yehrus, and also reaches all of the major cities. To this day, it remains the world's leading example in long-distance rail design.

entries.name: Nameless Heroes Memorial
entries.content:
Nameless Heroes Memorial
A structure that memorializes the Yehrus soldiers who sacrificed their lives in the two wars during the days of the Federation. As the fighting continued, so did the number of heroes.

entries.name: data miner
entries.content: Data miners: Humans can connect their brains to the Internet by wearing special headsets, contributing computing power to different AI networks and gain profits from them. This does not require any threshold and is a way for many lower classes to pay for the cost of Baldr Inhibitors.

entries.name: Opal Voucher
entries.content:
Opal Voucher: Gigi exchange item (Base - Gigi)
Vouchers given to Yggdrasil employees. Can be used to exchange for various furniture and objects from the company's resource department, even custom-made ones.

entries.name: The Camps
entries.content:
The Camps
A settlement established by the residents of the Buffer Sections. Many more of the residents opted to join the Coyotes than the Adventists.
The cheap dwellings found here are often built against the Third Containment Wall, offering poor living conditions with no semblance of public order.
Unlike the residents of The Towers, whose lives are protected by the Yggdrasil Enterprises, the people living here are a group of people with "no human rights."
primarily composed of young people and families that have contracted Juvenile Crystalosis and are unable to seek a cure, data miners that have lost their livelihood to the Al revolution, the unemployed, convicts, and opportunists entering the Containment Zone with hopes of profiting from Titagen.

entries.name: Quantum Cell,Fiber Axon
entries.content:
Nerve channel materials: Used to strengthen Theotropic Nerves
Fiber Axon: A bionic cell component that greatly improves reflexes.
Quantum Cell: A bionic cell component with an excitation memory function to improve processing abilities.

entries.name: Heartflow Garden
entries.content: Heartflow Garden is a healing facility in New Hentiro with many recovery pods, managed directly by GANGES. Due to GANGES's immense computing power, they can cure complex symptoms that even Yggdrasil's pods cannot handle

entries.name: Nyanpasu
entries.content:
Nyanpasu is Mauxir’s novel penname. She has written two novels, "After a Three-Year Long Coma, He Awoke to Confessions From Thirteen Secret Lovers" and "Fifteen Confessions". The male protagonist based on the Adjutant.
Although Mauxir was more of an observer before, when getting along with the Adjustant, She have gradually learned to share some of the most delicate emotions of mankind, among them, is "desire to monopolize." She is  thinking, maybe the last part of this trio could be..."He and His Kitten Live Happily Ever After."

entries.name: Navication Stone
entries.content:
Navication Stone
"Navigation Stones" interact with the Titagen contamination found with the Zones in such a way as to make the Titagen particles visible. Even in extreme environments unsuited to the use of electronic devices, the stones can be used to detect and avoid areas with high concentrations of Titagen.
Some bullets are made using similar technology, causing more damage to Titans, but are also more expensive and rarer.

entries.name: New Territory
entries.content:
The New Territory is a region in the middle of the continent that is bordered by Holme, Yehrus, Ulster, and Philossia. Historically, it was considered a barren wasteland due to its landlocked position and absence of rivers, and remained unexplored until recent industrialization drove the Ulster people to explore eastward, where they stumbled upon gold and oil. Eventual disagreement over control of this region triggered the New Territory War, leading to the region's independence. Today, the New Territory is an active young player in the continent's political scene.
Similar to real-world USA.
Known areas:
Angeles City
Angeles University
Crado Prairie

entries.name: Woden's Remains
entries.content:
Woden's Remains
After Nascent Woden's defeat, the remains of the Demiurge Handmaiden were scattered across New Hentiro. These remains have special physical properties and, unlike Titagen, are invisible to the naked eye even when in physical form, making them hard to recover through conventional methods.
Further research has shown that Woden's remains emit a high-frequency signal that Demiurges or Demiurge Handmaidens can detect, allowing their location to be identified. The potential function of Woden's remains is still uncertain.

entries.name: Holme
entries.content:
Holme is a region in Snowbreak world. It is where the headquarters of Yggdrasil and Containment Zone Aleph (formerly Midgard) are located.
Equivalent to real-world Nordic regions.

entries.name: Midgard
entries.content: Midgard is the city in which Containment Zone Aleph is located. Midgard was the biggest city in the entire world before the Descent in 2057, and it also became the first to earn the moniker "City of Miracles" after the catastrophe. Located in the middle of the central plains of the Holme region, Midgard enjoys comfortable weather. The city was designed with strong urban planning, with zones specifically built for industry, commerce, and residence. In the early 2050s, Midgard boasted a population of over 40 million, and the area outside the Containment Zone is still home to nearly 10 million people today.

entries.name: Philossia
entries.content:
Philossia is a region in Snowbreak world. Similar to real-world Greece.
Known areas:
Charon Sea Base
Lykang

entries.name: Taigu-Connect Unmanned Transporter
entries.content:
Taigu-Connect Unmanned Transporter
The most important part of the Taigu-Connect transportation system. Together with the rail transportation system, they consist of the TAIGU unmanned transportation system. Despite there being a manual console in the transporter, it is still not suitable for carrying passengers since its speed and stability are completely designed for logistics operations. However, it is said, that each new TAIGU staff member is tricked by their seniors to take rides inside the transporter, which seems to have become an initiation ritual for rookies.

entries.name: Taigu-Connect Vault
entries.content:
Taigu-Connect Vault
There are multiple levels of safes inside to safely store various valuables and essential documents, including those that require "secret transportation" for Taigu-Connect's underground business. The Vault is located in a particular area of the Taigu-Connect Aleph Zone branch. It adopts multi-level security measures, including security robots, surveillance cameras, intrusion alarm systems, and other high-tech methods. Entering the Vault must be authorized by the manager, Cangyao.

entries.name: Apotheosis System
entries.content: The Apotheosis System (Apo-Sys for short) is a system developed by Yggdrasil Enterprises that is used exclusively by the Heimdall Force. Essentially a drug delivery system built directly into the exosuit that injects Baldr Inhibitors into the user's Theotropic Nerves. It changes the activation threshold of the Theotropic Nerves, thereby enhancing the Manifestation's combat abilities. It must be used wisely, however, as excessive injections will accelerate the Flooding process.

entries.name: Pact of Antimony
entries.content:
Pact of Antimony:
A special Titan that was spotted in Containment Zone Aleph. Its form is fairly different from Titans recorded in the past, and the way it attacks resembles that of Manifestations. After careful analysis, it was determined that the Titan was created by the fusion of Cherno and her alter ego, Meursault. Fortunately, for reasons that are not clear, the two were not completely fused together and Cherno was able to sever herself from the Titan.
A voluptuous Titan with twin batons. Its chest is hollow and Cherno is trapped inside.

entries.name: Nightborne Phantom
entries.content:
Nightborne Phantom:
An enemy that is actually a puppet possessed by a special Demiurge Handmaiden. It has a number of features similar to Nascent Woden. Post-encounter analysis reveals traits of the god "Dionysus." Because it was initially hard to confirm if it was a Demiurge, Vidya suggested calling the enemy "Nightborne Phantom."
It has white and purple shell and holds a white staff.
Weakspots
Nightborne Phantom's head is its weakspot. Shot that hits its head has 100% chance to deal CRIT and does not ricochet.
Limbs
The armor on Nightborne Phantom's right shoulder and waist, the Jug of Corruption, and the Dionysian Rod are different parts. Destroy them to disable it.
Phase
During combat, Nightborne Phantom will drink from the Jug of Corruption to gain Ageless Corruption, and its destroyed limbs will be regenerated.

entries.name: Vidya
entries.content:
Vidya Shannon
birthday: June 14
Age: 23
Gender: Female
Height: 5'3
Occupation: Spy
Vidya has displayed literary and artistic talents since a young age. She created and posted lots of high-quality fan videos about the Valkyrie Games, which eventually caught the attention of Yggdrasil and earned her the position of broadcast director for the games. In the First Descent, Vidya was seriously injured at the scene but was soon rescued by a Security Department team led by the Adjutant. She wanted to thank the Adjutant but felt too self-conscious about her tragic appearance to do so, leaving her yearning buried in her heart.
Upon becoming a Manifestation, Vidya gained the attention of τ due to her special nature. She joined Laevatain under the codename Agave.
In 2061, while in New Hentiro pretending to be a journalist, Vidya got a special call from τ... This time, she was determined to meet the Adjutant she had long admired in the best possible light. Later, Vidya resigned from Laevatain and accepted the Adjutant's invitation to officially join the Heimdall Force.
Long black hair in low tied twintails, purple eyes, large breasts, eye glasses

entries.name: Orilla Water Park
entries.content:
Orilla Water Park: A water park run by Yggdrasil Enterprises off the eastern coast of Holme. It currently serves as an employee-only holiday destination, The giant wind turbines and expansive dikes not only help create a peaceful environment for the park, but also enhance its distinctive visual scenery. Right in the middle of the park, a striking tower replicate one of
the iconic landmarks from the old Valkyrie Games venue.

entries.name: Nascent Woden
entries.content:
Nascent Woden - Incipient:
A strong monster created by Rozan Khwarenah from π's secretary, Kim Ah-Yeon. As opposed to Titans, it still possesses consciousness and intelligence. However, it considers itself to be a god and no longer Kim Ah-Yeon. In battle, it displays powers and attack styles similar to Manifestations.
In this form she is very similar to the Demiurge Handmaidens: with purple glowing skin, massive breasts and hips, white and purple bodysuit with pelvic curtain, dark blue levitation half-cape, white veil and a silver Titagen double bladed spear
Nascent Woden - Demiurge:
A powerful enemy evolved from Nascent Woden. The colossal might it unleashes is able to shake the world. Its body has become larger, and its attacks have changed as well. Even on its own, it possesses earth-shattering power.
In addition to becoming larger, she has a golden halo and her cape has also turned golden, making her overall image more divine.
Combat Analysis
The combat against Nascent Wotan breaks down into three parts. When
Nascent Woden's attack hits a Manifestation, it steals a large amount of
S-Energy and deploys 1 [Eye of the Future], [Eye of the Present], or [Eye
of the Past], which explodes after a period of time. Different types of Eyes
have different blast effects, and you need to flexibly adapt to it. When
Nascent Woden is about to be defeated, it will enter Demiurge form, in
which it has more types of attacks. One crucial aspect in the final stage
of combat is a great maneuver to draw the thunder strikes while staying
within the boundaries of the purified zone.

entries.name: Underground Subway
entries.content:
As the underground transportation of the central city, the subway lines were constantly expanding, with an extremely complex structure that led to every corner of the city.
However, the Titan contamination and construction of the containment walls cut off its extensive subway lines, putting an end to its ability to transport the blood of the city.
Despite being abandoned to this day, it continues to accumulate contamination, with most of its tunnels gradually blocked off by Titagen, making it hard for ordinary people to enter. Eventually, it became the main establishment for the Adventists.

entries.name: Underground Drainage System
entries.content:
Built beneath the center of the city before The Descent, all of its underground drain systems were automated and managed with AI, which provided water supply and drainage for the entire city without needing any manual maintenance.
For a short time after The Descent, it continued to operate normally, providing citizens with the much-needed clean water and sewage drainage. However, no one could have predicted that a few months later, the Titagen buildup would render the drainage system completely useless. Instead, it would pump the Titan contamination into the city's water supply. While small amounts of the contamination weren't fatal by any means, it's still better to avoid the contamination as much as possible.
While building the Outer Wall, Yggdrasil Enterprises also halted maintenance of the underground drainage system and cut off the linkage between the drainage pipes between the city and Containment Zone Aleph. At this point, Yggdrasil Enterprises became the only means by which residents of Containment Zone Aleph could procure clean water.

entries.name: The Market
entries.content:
The Market:
People in different classes of society and living habits were isolated in Containment Zone Aleph. Over time, they have gradually accepted the loss of their original living conditions, as well as their former identity and honor. However, the habits that they formed over the years couldn't be broken so easily. Aside from what's needed for daily survival, people also have different needs for life and entertainment, paving the way for a new market.
Other merchants have found a new business opportunity, taking on greater risks to smuggle goods or transport people illegally from the Canyon for money. These "services" have naturally become popular in the market.

entries.name: Path of Discipline
entries.content:
Path of Discipline:
A simple funeral device of the Adventists, used for farewell ceremonies and disposing of the bodies of followers when a Titan Pyre is unavailable.
Its body consists of a number of square mobile pipes, and it is usually installed on a platform in the Inter-Tower Spaces. During the farewell ceremonies presided over by the Exarch, Purificants, Emissaries, or other high-ranking personnel, the funeral device is suspended in the air by drones. At the end of the ceremony, the pipes suck in the remains materialized by Titagen and discharge them into the air, utilizing the vertical air duct created by the surrounding tall buildings.
It has a similar function to that of Brisingamen, which is essentially just spreading the Titagen contamination.

entries.name: Snowstorm
entries.content:
The Snowstorm (Буран) was Yehrus' first autonomous shuttle to conduct a space flight. Over its 82 missions, it ferried hundreds of astronauts between Earth's surface and orbit, as well as transported thousands of tons of materials for space station construction. During Yehrus' golden age, every launch of the Snowstorm symbolized a leap forward in human aviation.
The space shuttle featured its autonomous navigation system, a self-developed technology of Yehrus that helped ensure the Snowstorm would never experience a single mishap during its extensive service. Additionally, it led the era in terms of its light weight, engine performance, and safety features. Yet due to the high requirements of its structural materials and cost, Yehrus struggled to produce another space shuttle like the Snowstorm. Although Gustav advocated for the development of a more economical model, the "Frostfire" Space Shuttle, he passed away before its completion, ultimately bringing Yehrus' spacecraft industry to a dismal end.

entries.name: Canyon of the Perished
entries.content: Canyon of the Perished: A canyon that cuts between the regions of Holme and Yehrus. The incredibly steep mountains leave but a long and narrow road through it. During the civil war in Yehrus at the beginning of the century, Gustav's troops ambushed a motorized combat division at this canyon, annihilating most of the enemy forces with minimal losses. Since then, it has been called the "Canyon of the Perished". Due to the Military's blockade on the Yehrus border following the collapse of the Federation, the Canyon of the Perished has become one of the few available land routes in and out of Yehrus. Therefore, despite the dangers here, many people still try to pass this canyon out of a desire for immense profits – or maybe simply the desire to survive.

Snowbreak Aku-MA
A medium-sized combat mech designed by Acacia and created with the tech support of Fritia. Incorporating Acacia's personal tastes into its design, it prioritizes aesthetics over functionality. It attacks using a diverse arsenal of weapons, but this comes with high energy consumption. most of its skills and details are inspired by classic mecha animes
Appearance: A super-deformed humanoid mecha with blue and white color scheme and fluorescent green trim, yellow eyes. heel wheel. has thrusters and can fly. Overall design is based on Ryūjinmaru and SD Gundam.
Nameing: "Aku-MA" comes from original Gundam's title, "Federation's White Devil". The mecha itself can divide into three sections and combine in the air, a tribute to original Gundam's Core Fighter.
Cockpit: A two-person cockpit, Acacia lies in the front and the Adjutant in the back (Inspired by Darling in the Franxx)
Equipment:
Automatic repair function
Fire Acacia's own frozen shuriken (but larger)
Dual beam sabers and particle cannons with pink energy
Fin Funnel (inspired by ν Gundam), fire beams or form a pyramid-shaped beam shield
Sekiha Love Love Tenkyoken (inspired by G Gundam)
When Snowbreak Aku-MA is overheat, exposes its weakspot – the energy core. This power core is located behind the mech's neck and is a reference to the Entry Plug from Evangelion.

entries.content:
The special exosuit "Infinite Sight" was developed with the help of GANGES, the supercomputer of New Hentiro, according to Yggdrasil's design. It is able to stabilize the Titagen in Lyfe's body.
After acquiring this exosuit, Lyfe no longer experiences pain due to the side effects of her Manifestation, and has full control over Odin's powers, allowing her to fly, levitate, teleport through lightning, and more.

entries.name: Beiting
entries.content:
Beiting is a provincial administrative region of Shuozhou and one of the "Seven Sentinels," located in the northwest and bordering eastern Holme. Despite being the largest of the seven, it has a sparse population, with most residents living on the desert's edge or around the Dui Ze oasis, while the rest of the vast desert hosts only a few gem hunters, traders, and construction workers.
The desert is dotted with statues of long forgotten-ancient gods, and there seem to be some ancient ruins underground.

entries.name: Prototype Inhibitors
entries.content: A Prototype Inhibitor is a Baldr Inhibitor from one of the batches produced at Mistilteinn Station's zero-gravity factory before the whole station was sealed off. Only a Prototype Inhibitor can guarantee the trigger of Manifestation (mass-produced Inhibitors can trigger Manifestation too, but it depends on luck). Prototype Inhibitors are extremely rare nowadays and are difficult to get a hold of, no matter how much money one might have.

entries.name: Three-Phase Transformation
entries.content: The nature of Titagen is unstable. When exposed to the surrounding environment, it might be converted between matter, energy, and information. People affected by Titagen will also experience transformations between these three phases, namely, turning into a Changed (due to the convergence of Titagen as matter), evaporating in the air (due to the effusion of Titagen as energy), and transforming into a fragmented phantom (due to the dispelling of Titagen as information). Led by Yggdrasil Enterprises, there are people seeking ways to achieve controllable three-phase transformation.

entries.name: Beiting Underground
entries.content: These is a massive cavern system beneath Beiting. According to data gathered by field agent Bubu, it primarily consists of naturally-formed caves and an underground mine, with some areas still containing undiscovered ancient ruins. The mine was abandoned decades ago, and the surrounding area has long been desolated and uninhabited. Its general vibe is similar to Skyrim's Blackreach, with underground rivers, unique ecosystem and glowing mushrooms.

entries.name: Bubu
entries.content:
Bubu (卜卜)
Date of birth: January 31
Age: 19
Height: 5'3 (161cm)
Appearance: shortstack, grey eyes, white hair in twintails with red highlights, copper coins and red strings as hair accessories.
Biography:
Met the requirements for the Manifestation selection process and was administered Baldr Inhibitors. A cheerful Shuozhou girl who began her journey at Yggdrasil years ago. Obsessed with feng shui and other esoteric practices, she calls herself "the Geomancer." She served as a field agent on the Spindle System project. After an extraordinary adventure with the Adjutant (Adjutant entered her spiritual world and woke her up from coma due to injuries sustained in field operation), she formally joined the Heimdall Force.
This upbeat and clever girl regularly makes references to geomancy and divination, even in her self-introduction. At first, her words may come across as a bit odd, leaving you wondering if she's serious or just indulging in some teenage delusions. Driven by a hero-like sense of duty, Bubu approaches company missions with surprising earnestness, never hesitating to step in and protect the innocent and her squamates. Of course, this same trait makes her get a bit carried away with pride whenever she receives praise.

entries.content: The Spindle System is a system developed by Yggdrasil that allows field agents to capture the surrounding scene with their devices and reconstruct it in virtual space, allowing users to discover all the tiny details that the field agents didn't notice.

entries.name: Kirov
entries.content: The YFS Kirov was one of the heavy battleships that Leader Gustav ordered to be constructed after the Yehrus Federation's founding. With a full-load displacement of 30,000 tons, it was claimed to be the largest warship of the mid-21st century. Not just an ordinary ship, it served as a flagship of the Federation Navy and became a symbol of great pride for Yehrus in those old days. However, the fate of Navy ships was largely unfortunate after the collapse of the Federation. The YFS Kirov changed hands many times among various warlords, until it was attacked one day while anchored in Second Port. Unable to escape due to the frozen ice, the pride of the old Federation was destroyed by the fires of war in the port.

Biography
Born in Yehrus, she was renowned as chief investigator at the Academica Acropolis. Once an orphan until adopted by Madam Morozova, an aerospace expert. For the sake of a family member, she worked hard to hone herself into a powerful warrior, a path she preferred to walk alone. Upon learning of her family member's passing, she fell into a period of deep confusion and despair. During an assignment to investigate Charon Sea Base, she crossed paths with the Adjutant. Amidst the turmoil, they probed and clashed until they gradually came to understand each other and collaborate seamlessly, an undeniable pull forming between them. The Adjutant showed her what true strength was, sending ripples through the still waters of her once-unshaken heart.
She may claim to have no preferences, but deep-sea creatures are an exception. Her room is decorated with deep-sea items, including jellyfish plushies and mosasaurus models. She even casually shares facts about the Styx jellyfish with the Adjutant.

However, other members of the Elders don't seem to care much about it. Perhaps to them, it isn't a bad thing.
θ's appearance is that of a woman with long white hair and amber eyes, wearing a red and white cheongsam. Her body appears to be mostly cybernetic, with ball joints.
Although she promoted the establishment of a healthcare system, she also conducted illegal human experiments in Shuozhou's Underground Lab for immortality. One of her research results is θ-Inversion, her exosuit, which has two forms: Nirvana and Samsara.
Our company is about to start work on the No. 62 "New Medical Insurance System Pilot Zone."
As everyone knows, "Ensuring that each person has the right to live" is an important value that our company has held since its inception. The founder of this concept is our lovely and respectable Elder θ; she was also the individual to put forward the idea of a "new universal healthcare system" in the era of Juvosis, with the sole purpose of ensuring the right to live and protecting the entire population as they age.

entries.name: θ - Inversion
entries.content:
θ - Inversion is the tactical exosuit for the former Director member θ. It harnesses the tree power found in the Underground Lab. It can unleash incredible power within a short timeframe, as well as swiftly control the deadly mechanisms in the Duality Vault. 
θ - Inversion has two forms that she can switch between in battle: Nirvana and Samsara. They each have their own HP and Shields. θ - Inversion (Nirvana) is more adept at attacking from afar, while θ - Inversion (Samsara) prefers to engage at close range.
In Nirvana form, her exosuit turns green and she can summon umbrella turrets to attack. In Samsara form, her exosuit turns red and she turns her umbrella into a pair of bladed folding fans to slash.

entries.name: Ancient Manor
entries.content:
Mysterious Ancient Manor:
A manor in Shuozhou, both grand and elegant. Its structural design seems to have undergone some unique modifications.
After Bubu finally woke up, they had the data files documenting her important discoveries, including a mysterious manor in Shuozhou with more to it than meets the eye. It utilizes esoteric feng shui techniques to conceal its location, while the interior is full of meticulously designed mechanisms, seemingly hiding deep secrets within.
Underground Lab:
A lab beneath the ancient manor in Shuozhou. It was created by θ, a former member of Yggdrasil's Board of Directors.
Duality Vault:
A hidden chamber that θ designed to help her achieve immortality. The power from the Tree in the Shrine converges here.

entries.name: Morpheus
entries.content:
Morpheus is a Demiurge, affiliated with the Khwarenah Faction. First discovered in Containment Zone 16, She can absorb Titagen for her own use.
Her human form has long grey hair, amber eyes, black horns, and wears a blue-black gothic dress. Her Demiurge form is called Morpheus - Vainbloom, and has a large white Titan-like body, cicada-like wings, and a blue moon-shaped decoration on her back.
In combat, she glides with cicada-like wings and unleashes Titagen-powered attacks, and can create illusions to confuse her enemies. For some reason, she seems uninterested in fighting, remaining passive in both words and actions, and she always gives priority to trying to escape when fighting.

entries.name: Khwarenah, Rozan Khwarenah
entries.content:
Khwarenah is a faction lead by Rozan Khwarenah, a thoroughly corrupt, semi-autonomous group within the Military trying to exert their influence on Yehrus that chooses to back ω's ambition for godhood during the Yehrus arc. After Omega's defeat, the Khwarenah continued their plot.
Rozan Khwarenah is a tall Yehrussian woman with long black hair and aqua eyes, usually wearing a gold military jacket. She was once a Manifestation, but voluntarily abandoned her humanity to become a Demiurge. She claims to have joined the Military to satisfy her desire to inflict violence on others. She has similar powers to control Titagen like the Adjutant. She funded research on Awakening Dust, using them to turn ordinary people into their servants. She pretends to be a friendly bartender named "Rosani" to get close to the Adjutant when they first meet in New Hentiro. She is a lustful and seductive villainess, trying to seduce the Adjutant to her side to become the new Adam and Eve to replace the rest of humanity.

entries.name: Iron Ouroboros
entries.content:
Iron Ouroboros: A massive, metal-clad creature that dives through the desert sands of Beiting as swiftly as a shadow. Ancient folk legends describe the creature as capable of infinite growth, representing endless hunger and evolution. It embodies an image of punishment, believed to grant dominion and eternal life to its owner. Ironically, this fearsome beast often proves unfaithful to the very master who seeks its loyalty.
Traits
Weakspots
When Iron Ouroboros' neck armor is destroyed, exposes its weakspot – the power core in its mouth. Shot hits on this part have 100% chance to deal CRIT, do not ricochet, and deal much greater DMG.
Phase
After transforming into a more powerful form, Iron Ouroboros can conjure powerful tornadoes that deal different types of DMG upon contact. As the beast absorbs these tornadoes, it rejuvenates its Shield.

entries.name: Charon Sea Base
entries.content:
Charon Sea Base
A research facility built by Yggdrasil and the Academica Acropolis in the southern waters of Holme. It's been abandoned for some time.
Nestled in the southern waters of Holme, it was a joint project led by Yggdrasil and the Academica Acropolis, aimed at developing an AI system to ensure human safety in extreme environments. The result of their research was Charon, an advanced AI system.
However, its development was shut down for violating the ban on sentient Al. Yggdrasil exerted heavy pressure on the Academica Acropolis to terminate the project.
Seafloor Lab
A lab located on the lowest level of Charon Sea Base. Data of the AI called "Yogurt" is stored here.

entries.name: Yogurt
entries.content:
Yogurt is an android incarnation of Charon Sea Base's AI, discovered and named by Adjutant and Nerida while they were exploring the base.
Yogurt is a petite girl with brown skin, long white hair, blue eyes, a white dress, and a blue coral-like hairpiece. She is curious, friendly, and helpful, but is also conflicted about her creation, the sentience she was given, and the choices that humans were forced to seal her.
During their exploration of Charon Sea Base, her AI was hacked by Edda, causing her mechanical parts to manifest as a spherical entity known as the "Abyss Watcher". After the Abyss Watcher was defeated, Yogurt was brought back to Heimdall and taken care of by Nozomi.

entries.name: Abyss Watcher
entries.content:
Abyss Watcher: The mechanical form of the Al called "Yogurt" as manifested under Edda's control. As the sovereign of Charon Sea Base, it commands the Acropolis sentinels as its servants. Like a pearl of the abyss or an illusory sun in the depths, it heralds the first light of dawn for a new world.
Traits
Energy Shield
Abyss Watcher is protected by Energy Shield, which is highly vulnerable to Skill DMG.
Phase
Abyss Watcher remains Invulnerable until all summoned Type-I and Type-II Acropolis Sentinels are defeated. After nuking, Abyss Watcher has its shield shattered, reducing Ricochet Rate.

entries.name: Mimir Sodas
entries.content:
Mimir Sodas is a popular beverage in the Snowbreak world. Its packaging and colors seem to be equivalent to real-world Coca-Cola. Fenny once endorsed this drink, and its advertisement can be seen playing on the screen on the second floor of Heimdall Base.
Slogan: Gentle and tough, Mimir Sodas.

entries.name: Director π
entries.content:
Director π, real name Erza Dawi, was one of the Directors of Yggdrasil in charge of promotional affairs, before being ousted from power by 𝜏. She is also the daughter of Dr. Kalpana Dawi, the creator of the GANGES supercomputer.
π has a petite body, medium black hair, purple eyes, and wears a white robe, purple corset and short skirt. This appearance is after plastic surgery, because 𝜏 is a disciple of Kalpana and knows her original self, so she changed her appearance and name to join Yggdrasil.
Her scientific philosophy sharply diverged from her mother’s. While Kalpana aimed to use GANGES for humanitarian purposes, Erza/Iπ pursued a colder, militaristic path—leading to her being sidelined from the GANGES project.
In the Realm of Illusion chapter, she lures the Adjutant and team into the illusory realm—a simulation based on Siris’s memories within the Tower of Hanoi—under the pretense that they share a common goal. Her true intent is to probe Siris’s mind, extract the system access key for GANGES, and seize control over it—and, by extension, New Hentiro itself.
After discovering her conspiracy, Adjutant and Siris fought against her virtual avatar, "π - Purified", in the virtual space and won, regaining control of GANGES, and using GANGES to locate π's physical location, sending a team to capture her. π was captured, and after confronting 𝜏 and saying her last words, she was executed.
